**nsEVDx**（JOSS 论文 `10.21105/joss.11187`；软件存档 `10.5281/zenodo.22307685`）**是一个**经 **JOSS** **同行评审**、**专**做**「**非**平稳**极值**建模」**的 **Python** 库****——**逐字自述**为**「**A Python Library for Stationary and Non-Stationary Extreme Value Modeling**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储聚合面的新子面**：**经**同行评审**的**研究**软件（**JOSS）**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-22 Crossref／Zenodo／GitHub 实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**做**的**是**「**非**平稳」**极值**，**而**不**只是**经典 **EVT****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**论文**标题**逐字**含 **`Stationary and Non-Stationary Extreme Value Modeling`****，**仓库**自述**逐字**为 **`Modeling Nonstationary Extreme Value Distributions`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**经典 **EVT** 假设**分布**不变**，**而**现实**里**趋势**（**气候**、**通胀**、**赔付**成本**）**会**让**同一**分位**数**的**含义**随时**间**变化**——**⭐ 故**「**百年**一遇**的**洪水」**这**句**话**若**不**说**明**基准**期**，**在**巨灾**与**再保**定价**里**就**会**被**误**用**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**巨灾**或**尾部**作业**时**，**先**问**「**平稳**假设**成**不**成**立」**，**再**谈**分位**数**。
**⭐⭐ ② 同**一**个**库**有**三**层 **DOI****，**而**这**三**层**各**管**一**件**事****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**论文 **DOI **`10.21105/joss.11187`****（**JOSS** 论文**，**2026-09-05）**；**软件**存档 **DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22307685`****（**记录逐字 **`v0.2.8`**、**类型 **`software`**、**许可 **`mit-license`**、**文件 **`Nischalcs50/nsEVDx-v0.2.8.zip` **4,912,325 B）**；**仓库 **README** 徽章**里**的**概念 **DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22238904`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**引用**软件**时**要**分清**「**论文** DOI」**（**指向**评审**记录）**与**「**我**实际**跑**的**版本 **DOI」**（**指向**可**复现**的**快照）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**作品集**与**报告**里**写**「**我**用 **nsEVDx **0.2.8」**并**附**存档 **DOI**，**比**只**写**库名**强**得**多**（**⭐ 与**第 **379** 轮**记下的**「**同一**工件**多 **DOI** 要**辨**版本**重定向」**同向）**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**把**工程**纪律**写**在 **README** 首**页**，**故**可**从**徽章**读出**质量**信号****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**含 **`python-3.9%2B`**、**PyPI** 版本**徽章**（**包名 **`nsEVDx`）**、**CI** 徽章**（**`actions/workflows/test.yml`）**、**codecov** 徽章**与**文档**站**（**`Nischalcs50.github.io/nsEVDx`）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**：**⭐ 即**「**有**没有**测试」**、**「**有**没有**文档」**、**「**上**没**上 **PyPI」**这**三**件**事**可以**在**打开 **README** 的**十**秒**内**看到**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**选**第三方**库**时**，**先**看**这三**个**徽章**，**能**省**掉**大量**试**错**。
**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 它**是**新**库**，**且**外部**验证**仅**为 **★14****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**GitHub **`Nischalcs50/nsEVDx`** 逐字**为 **★14、**许可 **MIT、**主**语言 **Python、**仓库 **27,722 KB、**创建 **2025-07-09、**末次**推送 **2026-09-05**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**经**同行**评审」**与**「**数值**行为**已被**广泛**验证」**是**两**件**事**——**⭐ 评审**主要**看**软件**的**贡献**、**文档**与**测试**，**不**等于**每个**估计**量**在**极端**数据**下**都**被**独立**复**算**过**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**用**新**库**做**结论**时**，**至少**用**第**二**种**方法**（**如 **R** 的 **`ismev`／**`extRemes`**）**对**照**一**个**关键**数字**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 本轮**的**检索**判据**（**可**复用）**：**⭐ **JOSS** 的 **Crossref** 记录**不**填 **`online-pub-date`****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**以 **`from-online-pub-date:2026-09-01`** 过滤 **JOSS**（**ISSN **2475-9066）**逐字**返回 **`total-results` **0****，**而**以 **`from-created-date:2026-09-05`** 过滤**逐字**返回 **16****；**⭐ 另**对照**实测**其**全量 **`total-results` **3,721****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**过**滤**器**用**错**字段」**与**「**该**面**真**的**没有**新**内容」**在**输出**上**完全**相同**（**都**是 **0）**——**⭐ 故**用**任**何**元数据**过滤**器**时**，**都**要**先**做**一次**对照**（**⭐ 与**第 **376** 轮 **`topic:`** 失效**判据**同**属**一类）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-evt]]、**[[insurance-quantile]] 与 **[[extremes]] 覆盖**极值**与**分位**数**工具**与**方法**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**经**同行**评审、**以**非**平稳**为**主**线**的 **Python** 极值**库**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先**问**平稳**假设**成**不**成立**，**再**谈**分位**数**；**② **引用**软件**要**带**版本**存档 **DOI**；**③ **从**徽章**读**测试**、**文档**与**发布**状态**；**④ **新**库**要**做**跨**实现**对照**；**⑤ **过滤**器**用错**字段**会**静默**返回 **0**，**必须**跑**对照**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装**其**包**、**未运行**其**任何**极值**拟合**或**诊断**，**故**不**主张**其**数值**正确性**、**收敛**行为**或**推断**质量**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**Crossref** 记录**、**Zenodo** 存档**记录**、**GitHub** 仓库**接口**与 **README** 前**段**，**未读**其**文档站**、**测试**代码**或**论文**正文**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**三**层 **DOI** 之间**的**对应**关系**（**只**核对了**三**者**均**可**解析**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**PyPI** 发布**与**仓库**版本**是否**同步**。**⑤ ⚠️ **★14** 为 **2026-09-22** 快照**，**会**变化**。**⑥ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**论文**发布日 **2026-09-05** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-22）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-22 所见**；**⚠️ 使用**极值**模型**做**定价**或**资本**结论**前**须**自行**验证**。

e.summary_en: This is a peer-reviewed Python library for stationary and non-stationary extreme value modelling, described by that single phrase, with one identifier on its review paper, a second on its archived software release, and a third conceptual identifier advertised by its repository, so a single library spans three layers of identifiers. **Measured this round**: the paper was published on the fifth of September inside the window and is credited to two named authors under an attribution licence, the archived release is a version numbered software record under an MIT licence shipping as an archive of about five megabytes, and the repository shows a modest star count, an MIT licence, one language, a repository of about twenty-eight megabytes, creation in mid-2025, and a push on the same day as the paper. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a new sub-surface within cross-repository aggregation, namely peer-reviewed research software, and the round also produced a reusable retrieval criterion: the review journal records carry no online publication date, so filtering on that field silently returns nothing, and a date-created filter had to be used instead, which is the same class of silent failure as the topic qualifier recorded earlier.** **Four things are worth reading: it handles non-stationary rather than only classical extreme value modelling, so when the distribution itself drifts with time or covariates, return periods and quantiles drift too, which matters because a statement about a once-in-a-century event is misleading unless the baseline period is named; one library carries three identifiers, so citing software means separating the paper identifier from the identifier of the version actually run; the repository puts engineering discipline on its readme front page, with a minimum Python version, a package index badge, continuous integration, coverage reporting, and a documentation site, which means having tests and documentation is information a reader can see from badges; and the modest star count and repository size mark it as a new library, so numerical behaviour should still be checked independently.** **The library was not installed and no fit was run this round.**

e.body_en:
This is a peer-reviewed Python library for stationary and non-stationary extreme value modelling. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a new sub-surface within cross-repository aggregation, namely peer-reviewed research software.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-22 from the Crossref, Zenodo, and repository interfaces**:
**First, it handles non-stationary rather than only classical extreme value modelling.** The paper title names both stationary and non-stationary modelling, and the repository describes itself as modelling nonstationary extreme value distributions. **Classical extreme value theory assumes a fixed distribution, whereas trends in climate, inflation, or claims cost move the meaning of the same quantile over time, so a statement about a once-in-a-century event is misleading unless the baseline period is named, and the first question in catastrophe or tail work should be whether the stationarity assumption holds.**
**Second, one library carries three identifiers, each doing a different job.** The review paper has one identifier dated the fifth of September, the archived software release has a second at a version numbered record typed as software under an MIT licence shipping as an archive of about five megabytes, and the repository readme advertises a third conceptual identifier. **Citing software therefore means separating the paper identifier, which points at the review record, from the identifier of the version actually run, which points at a reproducible snapshot, and writing the version alongside the archive identifier is far stronger than naming the library alone, in the same spirit as the earlier note that multiple identifiers for one artefact must be distinguished from version redirects.**
**Third, it puts engineering discipline on the readme front page, so quality signals can be read from badges.** The readme carries a minimum Python version, a package index version badge, a continuous integration badge, a coverage badge, and a documentation site. **Whether there are tests, whether there is documentation, and whether the package is published can all be seen within seconds of opening the readme, which saves a great deal of trial and error when choosing a third-party library.**
**Fourth, it is a new library and external validation stands at a modest star count.** The repository shows an MIT licence, one language, a repository of about twenty-eight megabytes, creation in mid-2025, and a push on the same day as the paper. **Passing peer review and having numerical behaviour widely validated are two different things, since review mainly examines contribution, documentation, and tests rather than independently recomputing every estimator under extreme data, so at least one key number should be checked against a second implementation.**
**Fifth, this round produced a reusable retrieval criterion.** The review journal records carry no online publication date, so filtering on that field returns nothing while a date-created filter over the same window returns sixteen items against a total of several thousand. **A filter applied to the wrong field and a surface that genuinely has nothing new produce identical output, namely zero, so any metadata filter must be paired with a control query, which is the same class of silent failure as the topic qualifier recorded earlier.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover extreme value tooling, quantile methods, and extremes libraries, **while this entry supplies the form of a peer-reviewed Python extreme value library built around non-stationarity. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: ask whether stationarity holds before quoting a quantile; cite software with a version archive identifier; read tests, documentation, and release status from badges; cross-check a new library against another implementation; and always run a control when filtering metadata, since a wrong field fails silently.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed and no extreme value fit or diagnostic was run**, so no claim is made about numerical correctness, convergence, or inference quality. **Second, only the Crossref record, the archive record, the repository interface, and the opening of the readme were read**, not the documentation site, the test code, or the paper text. **Third, the correspondence among the three identifiers was not verified**, only that all three resolve. **Fourth, whether the package index release and the repository are in sync was not verified. Fifth, the star count is a snapshot from the twenty-second of September and will change. Sixth, the paper was published inside this round window against a baseline of that date. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that using extreme value models for pricing or capital conclusions requires independent verification.**

**nsEVDx**（JOSS 論文 `10.21105/joss.11187`；軟件存檔 `10.5281/zenodo.22307685`）**是一個**經 **JOSS 同行評審**、**專**做**「**非**平穩**極值**建模」**的 **Python** 庫****——**逐字自述**為**「**A Python Library for Stationary and Non-Stationary Extreme Value Modeling**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**跨倉儲聚合面的新子面**：**經同行評審的研究軟件（**JOSS）**」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-22 Crossref／Zenodo／GitHub 實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 做的是非平穩極值**——**倉庫自述逐字**Modeling Nonstationary Extreme Value Distributions**；**⭐ 即**經典 EVT 假設分布不變**，**而趨勢會讓同一分位數的含義隨時間變化**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**做巨災或尾部作業時先問平穩假設成不成立**。
**⭐⭐ ② 同一庫有三層 DOI**——**論文 `10.21105/joss.11187`**；**軟件存檔 `10.5281/zenodo.22307685`（**`v0.2.8`、**`software`、**`mit-license`、**文件 4,912,325 B）**；**README 徽章概念 DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22238904`**；**⭐ 即**引用軟件要分清論文 DOI 與所跑版本的 DOI**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 把工程紀律寫在 README 首頁**——**逐字含 Python 3.9+、**PyPI 徽章、**CI 徽章、**codecov 與**文檔站**；**⭐ 即**有沒有測試、**文檔、**上沒上 PyPI 可從徽章十秒讀出**。
**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 新庫且外部驗證僅 ★14**——**逐字 ★14、**MIT、**Python、**27,722 KB、**創建 2025-07-09、**末次推送 2026-09-05**；**⭐ 即**經同行評審不等於數值行為已被廣泛驗證**，**至少用第二種實現對照一個關鍵數字**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 本輪檢索判據**——**JOSS 的 Crossref 記錄不填 `online-pub-date`**：**用該字段過濾返回 0，**用 `from-created-date:2026-09-05` 返回 16，**全量 3,721**；**⭐ 即**過濾器用錯字段與該面真的沒有新內容，輸出完全相同（都是 0）**，**故必須跑對照**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurance-evt]]、[[insurance-quantile]]、[[extremes]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**經同行評審、**以非平穩為主線的 Python 極值庫**」**這一形態**。
**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先問平穩假設**；**② **引用帶版本存檔 DOI**；**③ **從徽章讀質量信號**；**④ **新庫做跨實現對照**；**⑤ **過濾器必須跑對照**。
